summary: Chart gains a headline slot and a fading area. headline: an element under the title (ChartCard's figure and change); when present the description is visually hidden and stays the accessible description. Chart.Areas / AreaChart wash="fade": the slot's solid colour at 28% at the top of the area, clear at the baseline (the Line sheet's Fading area); overlaid areas only — the AreaChart type refuses it with isStacked, and Chart.Areas draws stacked bands flat.
